bundle.title: The Harness Engineering Series
bundle.saved: Save $97 vs. booking the four separately
bundle.note: All four core workshops — Charter, Harness, Factory, Orchestrator — in one track.

items.title: Junior to Senior in the Age of AI
items.description: The agent changes what it means to be junior more than what it means to be senior. Build the judgment the tool can't supply.

items.title: Charter
items.description: Author the standard that governs an agent. Prose, no code — the layered spec every run answers to.

items.title: Harness
items.description: Build the engine that applies the charter to a single run. agent = model + harness.

items.title: Factory
items.description: Build the runtime line that runs agent processes into delivered work: ticket → PR. The meta-harness.

items.title: Orchestrator
items.description: Build the harness that manages multiple agents: one lead, N workers, run in parallel, then merged.

items.title: Deep Agents on LangChain / LangGraph
items.description: Build an orchestrating Deep Agent: a producer that delegates to specialist subagents, end to end, from scaffolding to a packaged result.

items.title: Pydantic AI
items.description: Build a real harness and orchestrator on Pydantic AI — from one validated unit of work to a producer delegating across specialist agents.

items.title: Claude Code
items.description: Go deep on Claude Code as a harness — commands, hooks, subagents, MCP, and the seams that make it reliable on a real repo.

items.title: pi
items.description: Build a non-coding harness on the pi coding agent's extension surfaces, packaged as a service — a working SQL-analytics line end to end.

items.title: iii
items.description: Build a durable, graph-structured agent workflow on iii — worker nodes wired through a durable queue, from intake to synthesis.
